fasta.title: Reference FASTA
fasta.errorMessage: Must be an uncompressed FASTA file (.fa, .fasta or .fna)
fasta.description: Reference genome FASTA used to build the RSEM index. Must be uncompressed: rsem-prepare-reference cannot read a gzipped FASTA.

gtf.title: GTF Annotation
gtf.errorMessage: Must be a GTF file (.gtf or .gtf.gz)
gtf.description: Gene annotation GTF; rsem-prepare-reference uses it to define the transcripts.

rsem_version.title: RSEM Version
rsem_version.description: Select the specific version of RSEM to use (see quay.io/biocontainers/rsem for available versions)

rsem_extra_args.title: Extra Arguments
rsem_extra_args.description: Additional arguments to pass to rsem-prepare-reference.
